## Biography

We are looking for a funded PhD student to join the GATOR Lab (ideal start date: **Fall 2027**) — if we find the right fit!

Check out our [Join the Lab](../../join.qmd) page and the [Position Flyer (PDF)](/files/GATOR_Lab_UF_PhD_flyer.pdf) to see what we are looking for and how to apply.
